plugins.description: For B2B customer success managers: decide which accounts are at risk of churn and why, what to show in a QBR, how to onboard a new customer, when to pitch an upsell and how to save a renewal. Give it your notes, a CRM export or a plain conversation; get health scores, plans, review briefs and conversation guides. Built on Helix's GUARD method.
